thread.title: Apple down again after being surpassed by Microsoft in market-cap ranking

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Apple down again after being surpassed by Microsoft in market-cap ranking
text:
With Apple Inc.’s stock
 AAPL, -0.89%
 shedding 2.1% in premarket trade Tuesday, after President Trump said he was considering tariffs on iPhones , the technology giant is on track to open as just the second-biggest U.S. company by market capitalization. Based on 4,745,398,000 shares outstanding as of Oct. 26, according to the latest quarterly filings, Apple’s market cap would open at about $811.5 billion. Meanwhile, Microsoft Corp.’s stock
 MSFT, +0.48%
 was down 0.4% ahead of the open, which based on 7,676,218,736 shares outstanding as of Oct. 19 would put the software giant’s market cap at about $813.8 billion. Since the end of October, Apple’s market cap has declined by about $210 billion, while Microsoft’s market cap has declined by about $2.6 billion. Apple’s stock has shed 20% over the past three months while Microsoft shares have lost 2.9% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, +0.16%
 has given up 5.4%.
